---
title: "Isolated Autotrophic Relative - Biomass"
output: html_document
date: "2023-02-07"
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r}
ds_patches_effect_size %>%
  filter(trophic_type == "heterotrophic",
         flow == "relative") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = day,
             y = bioarea_per_volume_d,
             color = patch_size_ml
             )) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(dodging)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(dodging)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = bioarea_per_volume_d_lower,
        ymax = bioarea_per_volume_d_upper),
    width = .2,
    position = position_dodge(dodging)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = x_axis_date,
    y = y_axis_patch_bioarea_ES,
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = legend_position
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = resource_flow_days,
    linetype = resource_flow_line_type,
    color = resource_flow_line_color,
    size = resource_flow_line_size
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "black",
    size = 0.7
  )
```
